main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual next-bar move on forecast<0 bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and slope >= 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short-direction unusual move on abs(forecast)

decided_by: Mean short-direction unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and the slope on abs(forecast) is >= 0.
reading: Every bar with forecast < 0 and a next bar in the same window is a case (1-bar grid = every bar), the drift is the coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows, the day-clustered t sums the deviations per UTC day, and the slope is an ordinary least-squares fit.

direction_check.why: too few cases on the check folds (49 cases, 33 days)
